mappings.eligible_participants: derived from arm's own participant ID and nonempty summaries for both declared runs; no expected numeric value supplied
mappings.excluded_participants: complement of own declared single participant
mappings.flag_counts: baseline flat run flags with unexpected_response_code_value renamed; treatment nested flag_counts; onset diagnostics assessed separately
mappings.participant_changes_ms: results.change.value_ms baseline or .value treatment, keyed by own participant ID
mappings.run_summaries: results.runs: participant->participant_id, presented_trials->n_presented, retained_rt_count->n_retained, excluded_row_union->n_excluded_union, median_rt_ms->rt_ms
mappings.units: ms/milliseconds both mean milliseconds; no numeric conversion

reviewer: study_design agent; design/reference author; unblinded; did not author worker analyses
